name: Mihara (Kōchi, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Mihara village emblem in green: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised mountain range.
history: Municipal flag of Mihara, a village in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 September 1972.

features.role: Mihara village emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised mountain range
